film.title: 500-Ton rocking stone on a mountain peak: Omu di Cagna in Corsica
film.creator: Schwendi Colours
film.note: Schwendi Colours follows the climb to Omu di Cagna and its naturally balanced granite boulder, with views across southern Corsica. A landscape hike alongside the island’s built heritage.
film.placement_status: Regional guide: natural geological landmark, not an archaeological site

review: Uploader metadata and original frames at 120, 360 and 450 seconds confirm hiking and the summit boulder. Original title retained; its 500-ton claim is not independently verified or repeated in Atlas description. No archaeological pin created.
